name: ipv4-name-constraint-noncontiguous-mask-invalid
description: iPAddress name constraints must encode CIDR ranges. This CA encodes an IPv4 constraint with address 192.0.2.0 and non-contiguous mask 255.0.255.0. The constraint syntax is invalid and a critical extension with a present iPAddress name form must be rejected rather than treated as an arbitrary address-and-mask match.
notes: The raw nameConstraints value is SEQUENCE { permittedSubtrees = [{ iPAddress = C0 00 02 00 FF 00 FF 00 }] }. If an implementation only computes (addr & mask) == (constraint & mask), the leaf 192.123.2.45 appears to match; a CIDR-aware parser must reject the non-contiguous mask.
